The root blocker session_0ca3dcbe5c8b is 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead after having executed an UPDATE on inventory — it holds row locks and never committed. Resolution: rollback the eligible root blocker session_0ca3dcbe5c8b, which releases the lock chain and lets the business request complete. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
